description: MCLK, SCLK (64 Fs) and LRCK for I2S codecs that take their clocks from the FPGA (Cirrus CS4344/CS5343, Digilent Pmod I2S2), made from the system clock with counters only: Fs = clock / (MCLK_DIV · RATIO), e.g. 27 MHz / 1024 = 26.37 kHz, 100 MHz / 2048 = 48.83 kHz. Strobes tell i2s_transmitter when to change its bit and i2s_receiver when to take one.

de.description: MCLK, SCLK (64 Fs) und LRCK für I2S-Codecs, die ihre Takte vom FPGA bekommen (Cirrus CS4344/CS5343, Digilent Pmod I2S2), nur mit Zählern aus dem Systemtakt: Fs = Takt / (MCLK_DIV · RATIO), z. B. 27 MHz / 1024 = 26,37 kHz, 100 MHz / 2048 = 48,83 kHz. Strobes sagen i2s_transmitter, wann es sein Bit wechselt, und i2s_receiver, wann es eines übernimmt.
de.name: I2S-Takte
